gloss: to punctuate; to divide, to mark off

definitions.gloss: to divide, to mark off, to segment
definitions.explanation: To separate something into sections or segments by marking boundaries. Used for dividing text, time, space, or abstract concepts.

definitions.gloss: to bring to a close, to put a stop to
definitions.explanation: To mark a stopping point or conclusion in an activity or period.

examples.japanese: {文|ぶん}を{区切|くぎ}って{読|よ}む。
examples.english: Read by dividing the sentence into segments.

examples.japanese: カーテンで{部屋|へや}を{区切|くぎ}った。
examples.english: I divided the room with a curtain.

examples.japanese: {単語|たんご}と{単語|たんご}の{間|あいだ}にスペースを{入|い}れて{区切|くぎ}る。
examples.english: Separate words by inserting spaces between them.

examples.japanese: ここで{一|ひと}つ{区切|くぎ}ろう。
{仕事|しごと}に{区切|くぎ}りをつけてから{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: I'll finish up my work before heading home.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}に{区切|くぎ}りをつけて{新|あたら}しい{生活|せいかつ}を{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to put the past behind me and start a new life.

notes:
The noun form {区切|くぎ}り is very common and often appears in the set phrase {区切|くぎ}りをつける (to bring something to a close, to draw a line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{区切|くぎ}りをつける — to bring to a close, to draw a line
・{一|ひと}つ{区切|くぎ}る — to pause/stop at one point
・{文|ぶん}を{区切|くぎ}る — to break a sentence into parts
・{段落|だんらく}で{区切|くぎ}る — to divide by paragraphs

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{分|わ}ける — to divide, to separate (more general)
・{仕切|しき}る — to partition, to manage
